content:
Last month, Anthropic announced plans to expand Claude Cowork from Mac to iPhone and iPad, with the initial phase available only to subscribers of Anthropic's most expensive paid plan.

As of today, Anthropic says Claude Cowork has fully launched across mobile and desktop platforms, and is available to all paid plans.

You can click here to learn more about the details of the mobile version launch of Anthropic's Claude Cowork.

Meanwhile, OpenAI has also launched its own solution, ChatGPT Work, which is similarly available on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and the web.
